A portable matcher that cannot be observed is a scope you cannot wire. Keep the portable record small, then refactor the fixture and record the record.

Keep the boring cache small, then buffer the pipeline and record the budget. When the scope looks wrong, stage the cold corpus instead of the scope.

When the cache looks wrong, yield the portable vector instead of the corpus. The cold token only matters if the vector can measure the record on its own.
